# trefolio

> The European investor's portfolio tracker — EU tax reports, stock screener, AI insights, and net worth tracking in 35 languages.

## What is trefolio?

trefolio is a web-based portfolio tracker built for European retail investors. It offers tax reports for 17 countries (Germany, France, Spain, Netherlands, Italy, UK, US, Switzerland, Austria, Portugal, Belgium, Ireland, Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland, Poland) with AI Tax Assistant, a stock screener covering 600+ stocks, net worth tracking (real estate, savings, pensions), broker auto-sync via SnapTrade (20+ brokerages), 14 broker CSV import formats, AI-powered analysis in your native language, dividend tracking and projections, performance metrics (TTWROR, XIRR, Sharpe, Max Drawdown), portfolio simulator (backtesting, what-if, stress testing), and 4 dashboard themes. Available in 35 European languages with 21-currency support.

## Pricing

- Free (Folio): Up to 15 holdings, real-time quotes, charts, growth projection, broker import, earnings calendar, 5 AI calls/month
- Bifolio (€2.99/month or €23.99/year): 50 holdings, 20 AI calls/month, full portfolio history, advanced metrics, portfolio sharing, CSV export, 1 broker sync, Canvas theme
- Trefolio (€7.99/month or €59.99/year): Unlimited holdings, unlimited AI, tax reports (17 countries), stock screener, portfolio simulator, net worth tracking, fundamentals, all 4 themes, unlimited broker sync, IPO calendar
